plugins.title: Hello Lab (example)
plugins.description: Example: menus, sub-menus, input, choices, background work, saved values.

plugins.title: Mornye (lab copy)
plugins.description: Copy of Mornye from link. The app's own Mornye is untouched; sessions are shared, settings are separate.

plugins.title: Link Lab (any site, copy of link_downloader)
plugins.description: Get links / download any site through yt-dlp, with free proxies or v2ray. Get links only also has a this-phone runner (this phone's IP, yt-dlp, no change to lab-links.yml). Uses the lab-links, lab-download and lab-find-proxies workflows; the app's own tools are untouched.

plugins.title: Get links only (با گوشی)
plugins.description: The phone reads qualities with yt-dlp (this phone's IP, no GitHub). Fast check of which sites work. Link Lab's Get links only is unchanged.

plugins.title: Copy tools (safe copy to edit)
plugins.description: Copy a main workflow or a config plugin to the lab branch, edit the copy, run it from lab, or discard it. The originals are never touched.

plugins.title: Page Sniffer (get m3u8 with my login)
plugins.description: Open a series/movie page in an in-app browser, log in with your account, press play: the tool catches the .m3u8 link. Then copy it or send it to lab-download (same as Link Lab).

plugins.title: Promote tool to Download Anything
plugins.description: Move a tested Lab tool to Download Anything (config branch + main workflows) with no build: dry-run preview, one commit per branch, Rollback.

plugins.title: Add workflow (link or paste)
plugins.description: Bring a workflow from a GitHub link or pasted .yml into the Lab as a new tool: checks it against what the app needs, one-tap fixes, run, copyable error report.

plugins.title: Download Pinterest video [imported]
plugins.description: Imported workflow lab-workflow.yml. Run, Check and a copyable error report inside; edit the workflow on the lab branch.

plugins.title: Pornhub Search Scraper [imported]
plugins.description: Imported workflow lab-pornhub-search-scraper.yml. Run, Check and a copyable error report inside; edit the workflow on the lab branch.

plugins.title: Free Iran Proxy List [imported]
plugins.description: Imported workflow lab-free-iran-proxy-list.yml. Run, Check and a copyable error report inside; edit the workflow on the lab branch.
